newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philequity fund says yr-to-date return 54.16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philequity fund says yr-to-date return 54.16 pct.

text.p: Manila's Philequity Fund said on Tuesday it posted a year-to-date return of 54.16 percent at close of trading on October 1, 1996.
The fund, one of six open-end mutual funds in the Philippines, said its net asset value (NAV) was 2.0660 pesos per share.
Sixto Sandejas, Philrealty corporate secretary, said in a statement that the sale is scheduled to take place on October 16, subject to a due diligence examination of PRCI.
He added that the agreement is also conditional on devising a mutually acceptable management role for LMB.
The statement gave no further details.
